neighbours.label: the first word of the name of a US federal regulatory agency, after 'U.S.' or 'the' (Environmental Protection Agency, Food and Drug Administration, Securities and Exchange Commission)
fire: Residents complained to the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency about the dump.
The drug still needs approval from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration.
The toy was recalled by the Consumer Product Safety Commission in March.
Executives were charged by the Securities and Exchange Commission last year.
The mill was fined by the Occupational Safety and Health Administration.
Airlines must report delays to the U.S. Federal Aviation Administration.
A lawyer wrote to the US Food and Drug Administration about the label.
Records from the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration show more crashes.
quiet: Residents complained to the mayor about environmental damage from the dump.
The drug still needs a brand name and a cheaper food coating.
The toy was recalled because consumers found sharp edges in March.
Executives sold their securities and bought a house last year.
The mill improved its occupational training for new employees.
Airlines must report delays to the airport in the U.S. town.
A lawyer wrote about the US food label and its small print.
Records from the national highway show more crashes near the bridge.

short: first word of a US regulator's name
notes: Card: ' Environmental' x10, ' Food' x10, ' Drug' x6, ' Consumer', ' Securities'. Probes: 0.87 Environmental, 0.85 Food, 0.74 Securities, 0.70 Consumer; 'U.S. Army' 0.163, 'Environmental damage' 0.079, 'Food prices' 0.031. New agencies are in the test (Occupational Safety and Health, Federal Aviation, National Highway Traffic Safety), and near misses keep the words as ordinary nouns.
